mechanism_correct_is_distribution.why: power is a NONLINEAR function of the threshold, so the MAGNITUDE of the loss is carried by the whole distribution of tau_c, not by its mean (Jensen: E[Phi((delta - tau_c)/se)] != Phi((delta - E[tau_c])/se)).

mechanism_gap_ordering.statistic: every unordered pair of informative cells whose mean standardised threshold gaps differ by more than 0.05, oriented by the gap
mechanism_gap_ordering.verdict: the mean gap ORDERS the factor
